messages:
Raj: Heads-up — I'm prepping the final lockfile bump for rc1. This touches a couple submodules (vendor/thirdparty/*) and bumps a few nested deps. Need a quick smoke pass from anyone who owns runtime infra, go libs, or the vendor pipeline before cutoff (today 18:00 PT).

Raj: Quick checklist I'm running: 
- update submodules: `git submodule update --init --recursive && git submodule foreach git pull origin main`
- regenerate vendor: `./scripts/vendor-refresh.sh`
- run lockfile checks: `./scripts/check-lockfiles.sh --ci`

Sara: On it. Starting with runtime tests locally, then will kick off the smoke CI flow. Will ping if anything flakes. :eyes:

Mike: FYI I hit a flake in batcher that looks like a transient grpc version mismatch after the vendor bump. Locally `go test ./pkg/batcher` fails with `rpc: version mismatch`.
Mike: Quick workaround: pin `google.golang.org/grpc v1.55.0` in `go.mod` and run `go mod tidy` — fixes the local run. Not sure if we should commit that or let vendor override.

Julia: For changelog — these vendor bumps include a tiny API fix in the tokenizer lib. I'll add a short note under "runtime" in CHANGELOG.md. Who owns tokenizer mention? @Mike?

Mike: I can add a one-liner. Also agree we should pin grpc in go.mod, then vendor will carry it through. I'll open a small PR against the lockfile branch.

DeployBot: CI smoke-run queued — GitHub Actions · smoke/lockfile-1832109876 — queued
DeployBot: CI smoke-run started — all checks: unit, integration-smoke, vendor-validate

Anika: If anyone is planning to push more submodule updates, please wait until the bump PR lands. We had merge conflicts yesterday when two subs were bumped separately.

Raj: Agreed. Cutoff is firm — no new submodule point upgrades after 17:30 PT. We can still do changelog + small pins until 18:00 PT.

Sara: CI green on smoke-run. No regressions in runtime tests. :tada:

Mike: PR opened: #4921 pin grpc + lockfile sync. Running full test suite now.

DeployBot: smoke/lockfile-1832109876 — success ✅

Raj: Thanks all. If anyone sees anything in the next hour, ping here. Otherwise I'll merge the bump at ~18:05 PT, then trigger release cut tomorrow morning. :shipit:

Anika: noted, will hold release branch until merge. :thumbsup:
